title: Wave 2 image-generation ledger
description: Every render is appended here at the moment it is requested, with its price — before the image comes back, so a crash cannot lose the dollar. Ivan's rule after the pilot wrote costUsd: 0 meaning 'not measured'.

balanceAtStartUsd.description: Read from the fal.ai dashboard at 02:20 WITA 2026-09-08.

ceilingUsd.description: HARD stop. Ivan: $6.00 out of $7.10, leaving $1.10 untouched.

softStopUsd.description: Above this, generate nothing that is not a reshoot of a rejected frame.

priceUsd.description: Price of THIS call, from the model page: nano-banana $0.039, nano-banana-pro $0.15 at 2K, $0.30 at 4K.

promptSha256.description: sha256 of the prompt ACTUALLY sent, so one cell can be rebuilt at full size without rereading the whole text.

reshootOf.description: id of the render this one replaces; a reshoot counts against the ceiling like any other.

accepted.description: null = not judged yet. false = rejected by the creative-director gate (W8).

spentUsd.description: Sum of renders[].priceUsd. A PREDICTION from the price list — the morning number Ivan reads comes from the fal.ai dashboard, not from here.

dashboardUsd.description: The dashboard figure, filled in at the end of the wave. Until then: null, never a guess.
